PARAMS = {
    "R":       (380.0, 220.0, 480.0),   # load/feedback resistor vout->vin [ohm]
    "gtarget": (1.45, 1.2, 2.2),        # worst-corner |gain| target (linear) used to size W1
    "L1":      (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),         # gain/replica nfet length
    "Lp":      (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),         # pmos mirror length
    "gmidp":   (8.0, 5.0, 12.0),        # pmos mirror gm/Id
    "kp":      (1.08, 0.9, 1.35),       # pmos over-current ratio (sets vout_dc slightly above vin)
    "vref":    (0.74, 0.70, 0.78),      # replica gate divider voltage at VDD=1.8
    "N":       (20.0, 8.0, 40.0),       # main/replica current ratio
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    R = p["R"]; L1 = p["L1"]; Lp = p["Lp"]; kp = p["kp"]
    N = int(round(p["N"])); vref = p["vref"]

    # worst-case gm per um of M1 at fixed Vgs = vin over all corners/temps
    Wt = 10.0
    worst_gm, max_id = 1e9, 0.0
    for c in ["tt", "ff", "ss", "sf", "fs"]:
        for t in [-40, 27, 125]:
            o = lut.at(c, t).op("n", Wt, L1, vin, 0.6)
            worst_gm = min(worst_gm, o["gm"] / Wt)
            max_id = max(max_id, o["Id"] / Wt)
    nom = lut.op("n", Wt, L1, vin, 0.6)
    gm_um, id_um, gmid1 = nom["gm"] / Wt, nom["Id"] / Wt, nom["gm_id"]

    gm_req = (p["gtarget"] * 1.08 + 1.0) / R          # 8% allowance for gds loading
    W1 = min(max(gm_req / max(worst_gm, 1e-9), 4.0), 4000.0)
    I1 = W1 * id_um
    Wr = max(W1 / N, 0.5)

    # sized ops (for caps / gds)
    m1 = lut.size("n", gmid1, L1, I1, vds=vin)
    Ir = I1 / N
    mpr = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], Lp, Ir, vds=1.0)
    Wp = min(mpr.W * N * kp, 4500.0)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], Lp, I1 * kp, vds=1.8 - vin)

    # divider for vref (ratiometric)
    Rtot = 60e3
    Rb = Rtot * vref / 1.8
    Ra = Rtot - Rb

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    # gain device and its replica
    n.M("M1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", round(W1, 2), L1)
    n.M("M1R", "pg", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", round(Wr, 2), L1)
    # pmos mirror load
    n.M("MPR", "pg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", round(mpr.W, 2), Lp)
    n.M("MP", "vout", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", round(Wp, 2), Lp)
    # feedback/load resistor vout -> vin
    n.R("RL", "vout", "vin", R)
    # reference divider
    n.R("RA", "vdd", "vref", Ra)
    n.R("RB", "vref", "vss", Rb)
    n.C("CREF", "vref", "vss", 2e-12)
    # ibias sink (diode) so IREF has a DC path
    n.M("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 4.0, 1.0)

    # --- predictions ---
    gds_tot = m1.gds + mp.gds
    Reff = 1.0 / (1.0 / R + gds_tot)
    gm1 = gm_um * W1
    gain = (gm1 * R - 1.0) / (1.0 + gds_tot * R)
    cout = cl + m1.cdd + m1.cgd + mp.cdd + mp.cgd
    f3db = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Reff * cout)
    # power worst: max corner current, VDD=1.98, vref error raises replica current
    dv = vref * 1.98 / 1.8 - vin
    boost = math.exp(min(gmid1 * dv, 2.0))
    Imax = max_id * W1
    power = 1.98 * (Imax * (1 + 1.0 / N) * kp * boost + 1.98 / Rtot + iref)
    ratio = kp * math.exp(gmid1 * (vref - vin))
    vout_dc = vin + (ratio - 1.0) * I1 * Reff
    swing = 0.62 * gain / (gain + 1.0) + 0.5 * I1 * Reff * 0.6
    return n, {"gain_db": db(max(gain, 1e-6)), "f3db": f3db, "gbw": gain * f3db,
               "power": power, "vout_dc": vout_dc, "swing": swing}
